boon_coupon_explain_contracts_discount:
1. To view your deduction coupons, 
KuCoin Thailand Futures website: Assets > Asset Overview. 
KuCoin Thailand app: Futures > Upper-right corner > Deduction Coupon.
2. Futures Deduction Coupons are automatically applied when users conduct futures trades. Fees will first be charged, then the deducted amount will be refunded into your Futures Account. For Coin-Margined contracts, refunds will be calculated based on the real-time exchange rates and be issued in USDT.
3. The system will automatically select available deduction coupons for use in the following order: Highest deduction ratio > Least number of days remaining > Previously used > Highest total face value.
4. Only one deduction coupon can be used per trade. Each deduction coupon can be used for multiple trades as long as it still has remaining unused amounts and has not yet expired.

margin_coupons_rules_content_new:
1. Interest-free coupons help reduce the interest accrued on your loans. The max discount is 100%, and the max deductible amount is the coupon's face value.
2. For loans in the same currency, only one coupon can be used at a time for deduction.
3. The minimum deduction precision for interest-free coupons is 0.00000001. Any unused interest deduction will automatically expire.
4. You can view your deduction history from your Margin Account details page. For more information, check out the KuCoin Thailand Help Center.
